facets.description: minimumTokenResponseSchema (parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 8-10): the computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` become fixed junk strings, not wildcard keys. The schema then requires a key that never exists, so it always fails in sync mode.
parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts line 26: when the response has no refresh_token, the literal 'refresh_token' placeholder is injected and saved, overwriting the real refresh token.
